about: Which layer each .mjs file belongs to (ARCHITECTURE.md 2.1). The most specific path wins; test/00-architecture.mjs fails on a file no rule covers and on an import that points up. The layers are declared here, not in folders, until P3 moves the game out and then the files (section 4). Where a file mixes two layers it takes the higher one. 'game' is what leaves for the H9 project in P3; 'example' may import anything.

ratchet.why: 2026-11-10, p3-battery: 90747 -> 90862 (+115): mapBattery and smak map-battery (+229 battery.mjs, +55 the command): every player-facing check over a built map read off the .bsp, the door fronts and spawn looks of the generator's battery ported to the built file (KIT-FAULTS 7); reachOf warns of a room-sized part of the floor not walked to (KIT-FAULTS 21), lightReport takes boxes of any height and says a room not walked to (KIT-FAULTS 22), sweepOf counts the sky as solid and gives up past 48 million cells instead of running out of memory (KIT-FAULTS 8), checkPvs and skyGaps take a walk made already; retired src/maps/lift.mjs (-215, an orphan with no consumer, on dormant/0.38). Before: 2026-11-10, p3b-seams merged over p3b-exact: 90731 -> 90747 (+16): skyGaps asks every eye, in the open too (the plaza walk's slivers at the Mese's arcades and the Milion's dome were seen from the street): a ray is through an opening only when two of the cone's rays opposite each other meet solid, and the opening is measured round where they met; retired the roof-walk that found where a ray left the roof and the six-of-eight cone rule, which the pair rule replaces; roof: any|under. Before: 2026-11-10, p3b-exact: 90676 -> 90731 (+55): turned exact at any angle (its quarter-only exact helper and the default-snap branch retired, snap kept for when it is asked), snap passed through frame.place and arcade, dome exact unless told; compileMap groups a repeated compiler warning into one sentence with its count, places and what to do (groupedWarnings, WARNING_KINDS: the 553 Ambiguous leafnode lines of the plaza), and reads the warnings hlbsp glues to its progress; checkPlan says off-grid planes as a fact. Before: 2026-11-10, p2b-check merged over p2b-sketch and p2b-forms: 90375 -> 90676 (+301): 2026-11-10, p2b-check: 90063 at the p2-battery2 merge; +301 for two checks from the plaza's walk: coplanarFaults in checkPlan (a brush entity's face on a face of the world or of another entity, looking the same way: z-fighting; the func_detail faces the compiler cuts away as a fact), skyGaps with smak map-skygaps (sky seen through an opening under 24 wide from the eyes under a roof, rays through the map's own tree); retired fidelity.mjs's own copy of leafAt (bsp.mjs has it) and check-pvs's inline json reader (jsonFlag, shared with map-skygaps). Before: 2026-11-10, p2b-sketch merged over p2b-forms: 90241 -> 90375 (+134): the sketch's pool kind (a space sunk in a floor, its func_water and kerb), the blind-street warning with its broken case, and a spiral stair that is a stair (wedges one rise thick on whole units, turned to face the door or floor at its top with a bridge onto it); the stair's 8-unit gap to its shaft retired, nothing else. Before: 2026-11-10, p2b-forms: 90063 -> 90241, +178 for the forms the plaza walk found wanting: railing kinds (bars, panel), the tree builder (round, cypress, palm), and scale on every builder of form with withScale and scaled; nothing retired (standingIn and pieceKey have no consumer in this tree but may have one in h9-maps). Before: 2026-11-10, p2-battery2 merged over p2-forms: 89594 at the P2 check merge; +192 forms (csgFaults, solidOfPlanes, the carve of turned outlines, rooms to their horizon, the sky as one box) and +277 battery 2 (fronts and spawns checks with their broken cases, the placers that keep a door off a wall and a column, the reach narrowed to the cells a player stands on); nothing retired in either. The most the kit (core+make+check+cli) may be; a commit that adds deletes as much, or raises this and says why here (ARCHITECTURE.md 2.3)
